testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/shopping-cart/verify-estimate-shipping-cost-for-retail-user.spec.ts > Webstore - Shopping Cart > verify estimate shipping cost section functionality for retail user

scenario.summary: A registered user signs in, empties the cart, adds one simple product and checks the Estimate Shipping Costs section: headings, button, blank and invalid zip code validation, then US and Canadian estimates each return a selectable flat-rate option; order summary Shipping and Handling Charges labels are checked when shown. Cart emptied, user logs out. No order is placed.
steps: Sign in with username/password (empty storage state at start)
Empty the cart, add sku1 with quantity 1 and open the cart
Check the Estimate Shipping Costs heading, zip code label and Estimate button
Click Estimate with no zip code and check the blank zip code message
Estimate for invalidZipCode and check the invalid zip code message

Estimate for zipCode_US: first shipping option name equals expectedShippingOptionName, rate shows a $ amount; select the flat option (#Flat-1); if the order summary shows Shipping / Handling Charges labels, check their texts; amounts logged only
Estimate for zipCode_Canada1: first option visible with a $ rate; select the flat option; same best-effort label check
Remove all items, check the empty cart message, log out and check the sign-in link
stateChanges: Registered user's cart: emptied, product added, shipping estimate selected, then all items removed
assertions: Estimate Shipping Costs heading, zip code label and Estimate button texts equal the test data
Blank zip code shows emptyZipCodeMsg; invalid zip code shows invalidZipCodeValidationMsg
Loading message equals shippingLoadingMessage (soft, tolerated if already cleared)
US: first shipping option is visible, its name equals expectedShippingOptionName and its rate matches /\$\d/
Canada: first shipping option is visible and its rate matches /\$\d/
When visible, order summary labels equal paraShippingLabel and paraHandlingChargesLabel (best effort, skipped when absent)
Empty cart message equals emptyShoppingCartMessage; sign-in link visible after logout
evidence: Title: 'verify estimate shipping cost section functionality for retail user'
Step '1) Sign in and add a product': loginPage.login(data.username, data.password), then cartPage.empty()
Profile: sku1 z-2420004 is an active published SimpleProduct (BlackAndDecker), inventory 235 (not filtered by store)

Profile: expectedShippingOptionName 'Custom Flat Rate' is the description of active custom shipping method FLAT (rule FixedRatePerItem, country US, handling 7.00); 2 rows matched, first on store MaxwellsHardwareMultistore (not filtered by store)
cartPage.selectFlatShipping clicks the fixed locator #Flat-1 and shippingOptionName reads spnShippingName1: the resolved shipping method must be code Flat and listed first
The test estimates for two destinations (US and Canada); SHIPPING_FLAT_RATE_ON_STORE takes one country, so the need is written for 'us' and the Canadian estimate is not covered by a key
Spec carries a MAINTENANCE NOTE (last run 2026-09-18 failed waiting for the empty cart message, not triaged): recorded as evidence only
